notes: No team page: periodic.com lists only the five-member Scientific Advisory Board, so headcount comes from archived LinkedIn member counts (a lower bound on staff that also includes interns and contractors who list the company).
LinkedIn member count tripled in 11 months (28 -> 88) while the size band stayed at 11-50.

Seed lead is reported as a16z (company site lists a16z first; Maginative and The Logic say a16z led). Others: Felicis, DST, NVentures, Accel, Radical Ventures, Khosla Ventures; angels Jeff Bezos, Elad Gil, Eric Schmidt, Jeff Dean. Reported seed valuation ~USD 1.3B.
2026 round: Bloomberg (Mar 2026) reported talks to raise hundreds of millions at ~USD 7B; Caproasia reported USD 500M. Not announced by the company as of 2026-10-09, so amount left null.

SEC: no Form D found for Periodic Labs itself (EDGAR company search 'periodic labs' returns nothing). One Form D exists for a Sydecar-administered SPV, 'AGC Wealt Periodic Labs I a Series of AGC AI Nexus Fund LLC' (first sale 2026-05-28, USD 4.74M from 7 investors): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2122824/000212282426000001/primary_doc.xml. That is secondary/SPV demand, not company funding.

Captured postings: 46 distinct Ashby posting IDs in Wayback (first capture 2025-09-30 to 2026-10-01) plus 10 live postings never captured, so >=56 postings in ~12 months. Quarter counts follow crawl timing (e.g., 13 first captured in one 2026-05-19 crawl).
Ashby publishedAt dates are reset on republish (a posting captured 2025-09-30 shows publishedAt 2026-07-09), so ATS dates were used only for postings Wayback never captured.
The launch-day board (2025-09-30) lists 14 roles plus a general application; the Wayback capture is gzip-encoded and embeds the postings as JSON (see job-postings/periodic-labs.md).
Some postings list Menlo Park and Montreal, Canada.
OpenAlex has no institution record for Periodic Labs; no registry headcount (US company).
